limitations: Normal, minimized, and the explicitly authorized own-app-setup continuation saves were verified through actual target DOM observations. Inactive-tab guarded saving was not performed.
Minimized state was sampled before and after its successful save; uninterrupted minimization and absence of transient restoration were not established.
The active:true management request was rejected and was not retried. Later known-ID samples showed target active and dummy inactive.

The state:normal setup request initially returned minimized, as did the immediate check. A separate later read returned normal without repeating the update; no causal or transition-time guarantee was established.
The initial own-app caret setup failed on a stale-state guard. That error is preserved separately from the later explicitly authorized fresh-state/click continuation.

The final UI-save interval was 5.304 seconds, including a 5.000-second initial guard observation. The source subsequently reported independent OS logs with probe_key_window=false and probe_is_frontmost=false; the required foreground caret and other-Space foreground setup was not met, so this interval does not validate preservation under that precondition.
The actor's own-app AX observations and source-reported fullscreen/selection log findings are separate evidence. No actual concurrent human typing was verified.
Pre/post URL identity checks do not eliminate navigation races or prove that the underlying host never collected other content.
Fixture wrapper bindings automatically returned only the authorized local pages' AX content; the runtime revision 2 browser guard itself used DOM snapshots without AX fallback.
The initial normal fixture displayed existing saved baseline state; a clean independent server-data baseline was not established.
This independent fixture test preserves the earlier unknown failure record and does not establish its original cause.
